messages:
Eileen: Heads-up for the SF offsite — I asked for a high-floor room facing away from Market St and it was way quieter. Also bring a small travel power strip, hotel outlets are sparse. https://tinyurl.com/sfo-offsite-shuttle
Samir: Great call. Anyone tried checking luggage at the airport kiosk vs curbside for faster drop?
Jamal: kiosk is usually faster if you only have 1 bag. Curbside is nice if you're running late but tip the handler :moneybag:.
Priya: Quick packing checklist I swear by: compact power strip, lightweight foldable rain jacket, noise-canceling earbuds, refillable water bottle.
Eileen: bumping that — also phone charger + USB-C hub. hotels sometimes only have 1 USB outlet next to bed.
Samir: Flight question — layover at SJC for 55 mins, is that reckless? Connecting domestic to domestic.
Jamal: 55 is tight but doable if same carrier and not changing terminals. If not, rebook to 1h20. Airside shuttle = stress.
Priya: pro tip: screenshot important confirmation emails and add them to Apple Wallet/Google Pay. No wifi? still there.
travel-bot: @channel Shuttle schedule updated: Free hotel shuttles departs 8:15, 9:00, 9:45 from Terminal 1 pickup zone C. More at https://hotel.example/shuttle (automated)
Eileen: Anyone down to split a cab from the airport to the hotel on Friday around 9:20? I can take 3 people and luggage. :raising_hand:
Samir: I’m in if Jamal and Priya are okay with an extra stop. saves $18 each. :dollar:
Jamal: I’ll take it. question — room swap policy if someone needs later checkout?
Priya: Front desk is usually flexible for a small fee or based on loyalty status. If you plan to stay late, ask at check-in and they’ll note it.
Eileen: OK we’re set. Small packing crutch: I pack a tiny cord organizer and slip it in my laptop sleeve — prevents the charger-tangle panic at security.
Samir: Also pro nightmare-avoidance: screenshot the parking/ride share pick up zone map. airports love to relocate zones.
Priya: For anyone bringing souvenirs — keep them in carry-on if fragile. Learned the hard way with ceramics. :(
Jamal: Last question: power adapter vs universal plug? I just carry a tiny universal cube — cheaper than buying adapters.
Eileen: universal cube + power strip = bliss. you keep everyone charged during post-offsite dinners. :sparkles:
travel-bot: Reminder: weather forecast for Offsite Weekend: light rain Sat morning, highs 62F, bring layers. (automated)
Priya: Thanks all — feel less chaotic now. See y’all Fri morning at the shuttle zone! :airplane:
